name: How does Discounted Roofing Co. determine if my storm damage warrants an insurance claim?

mainEntity.name: How does Discounted Roofing Co. determine if my storm damage warrants an insurance claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Discounted Roofing Co. assesses damage to identify if it meets the criteria typically required for an insurance claim, such as hail dents, wind-lifted shingles, or significant water intrusion. We document all findings with detailed reports and photographs. Our team provides an honest assessment of the damage and helps homeowners understand if filing a claim is likely to be successful, based on the severity and type of damage observed.
acceptedAnswer.description: We assess damage for insurance claim suitability, documenting findings to help determine if filing a claim is advisable.
